questions.question: Person P is willing to establish a mineral based industry. He has been advised to set up a bauxite industry in Odisha as a suitable way to make a profitable venture. Analyse the possible reasons behind the advice given.
answer_steps: Odisha was the largest bauxite-producing state in India (2016-17), so raw material is readily available.
The Panchpatmali deposits in Koraput district are the most important bauxite deposits in the state.
Aluminium, made from bauxite, is an important metal because it combines the strength of metals such as iron,
with extreme lightness, making it a good alternative to other metals,
and it also has good conductivity and great malleability, so demand for it is high.
questions.question_hi: व्यक्ति P एक खनिज-आधारित उद्योग लगाना चाहता है। उसे लाभदायक उद्यम के लिए ओडिशा में बॉक्साइट उद्योग लगाने की सलाह दी गई है। इस सलाह के संभावित कारणों का विश्लेषण कीजिए।
questions.question_gu: વ્યક્તિ P ખનિજ આધારિત ઉદ્યોગ સ્થાપવા માગે છે. તેને નફાકારક સાહસ માટે ઓડિશામાં બૉક્સાઇટ ઉદ્યોગ સ્થાપવાની સલાહ અપાઈ છે. આ સલાહનાં સંભવિત કારણોનું વિશ્લેષણ કરો.
answer_steps_hi: ओडिशा भारत का सबसे बड़ा बॉक्साइट उत्पादक राज्य था (2016-17), इसलिए कच्चा माल आसानी से उपलब्ध है।
कोरापुट ज़िले के पंचपटमाली निक्षेप राज्य के सबसे महत्त्वपूर्ण बॉक्साइट निक्षेप हैं।
बॉक्साइट से बना एल्युमिनियम एक महत्त्वपूर्ण धातु है क्योंकि इसमें लोहे जैसी धातुओं की शक्ति है,
अत्यधिक हल्केपन के साथ, जिससे यह अन्य धातुओं का अच्छा विकल्प है,
और इसमें अच्छी चालकता और अधिक आघातवर्धनीयता भी है, इसलिए इसकी माँग अधिक है।
answer_steps_gu: ઓડિશા ભારતનું સૌથી મોટું બૉક્સાઇટ ઉત્પાદક રાજ્ય હતું (2016-17), તેથી કાચો માલ સહેલાઈથી મળે છે.
કોરાપુટ જિલ્લાના પંચપટમાલી નિક્ષેપ રાજ્યના સૌથી મહત્ત્વના બૉક્સાઇટ નિક્ષેપ છે.
બૉક્સાઇટમાંથી બનતું ઍલ્યુમિનિયમ મહત્ત્વની ધાતુ છે કારણ કે તેમાં લોખંડ જેવી ધાતુઓની મજબૂતી છે,
અત્યંત હળવાશ સાથે, જેથી તે અન્ય ધાતુઓનો સારો વિકલ્પ છે,
અને તેમાં સારી વાહકતા અને વધુ ટીપવાની ક્ષમતા પણ છે, તેથી તેની માગ વધુ છે.

questions.question: 'Coal is the most important and abundant fossil fuel in India.' Justify the statement by evaluating the significant role it plays in the growth of the Indian economy in its different forms.
answer_steps: Coal is used for power generation and to supply energy to industry as well as for domestic needs; India is highly dependent on coal for commercial energy, e.g. in metallurgy.
Peat: decaying plants in swamps; low carbon, high moisture and low heating capacity.
Lignite: low-grade brown coal, soft with high moisture; main reserves at Neyveli (Tamil Nadu), used to generate electricity.
Bituminous: coal buried deep and subjected to higher temperatures; the most popular commercial coal; metallurgical coal is high-grade bituminous used to smelt iron in blast furnaces.
Anthracite: the highest quality hard coal.
questions.question_hi: 'कोयला भारत का सबसे महत्त्वपूर्ण और प्रचुर जीवाश्म ईंधन है।' इसके विभिन्न रूपों में भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था के विकास में इसकी महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका का मूल्यांकन करते हुए कथन का औचित्य सिद्ध कीजिए।
questions.question_gu: 'કોલસો ભારતનું સૌથી મહત્ત્વનું અને વિપુલ અશ્મિ ઇંધણ છે.' તેનાં જુદાં જુદાં સ્વરૂપોમાં ભારતીય અર્થતંત્રના વિકાસમાં તેની મહત્ત્વની ભૂમિકાનું મૂલ્યાંકન કરી વિધાનની યથાર્થતા સાબિત કરો.
answer_steps_hi: कोयले का उपयोग बिजली उत्पादन, उद्योगों और घरेलू ज़रूरतों के लिए ऊर्जा में होता है; भारत वाणिज्यिक ऊर्जा, जैसे धातुशोधन, के लिए कोयले पर बहुत निर्भर है।
पीट: दलदलों में सड़ते पौधों से; कम कार्बन, अधिक नमी और कम ताप क्षमता।
लिग्नाइट: निम्न कोटि का भूरा कोयला, मुलायम और अधिक नमी वाला; मुख्य भंडार नेवेली (तमिलनाडु) में, बिजली बनाने में प्रयुक्त।
बिटुमिनस: गहराई में दबा और अधिक तापमान से प्रभावित कोयला; सबसे लोकप्रिय वाणिज्यिक कोयला; धातुशोधन कोयला उच्च कोटि का बिटुमिनस है जो वात्या भट्टी में लोहा गलाने में प्रयुक्त होता है।
एंथ्रेसाइट: सर्वोत्तम गुण वाला कठोर कोयला।
answer_steps_gu: કોલસો વીજ ઉત્પાદન, ઉદ્યોગો અને ઘરેલુ જરૂરિયાતોની ઊર્જામાં વપરાય છે; ભારત વ્યાપારી ઊર્જા, જેમ કે ધાતુશોધન, માટે કોલસા પર ખૂબ આધાર રાખે છે.
પીટ: દલદલમાં સડતી વનસ્પતિમાંથી; ઓછો કાર્બન, વધુ ભેજ અને ઓછી ઉષ્મા ક્ષમતા.
લિગ્નાઇટ: નીચી ગુણવત્તાનો બદામી કોલસો, નરમ અને વધુ ભેજવાળો; મુખ્ય ભંડાર નેવેલી (તમિળનાડુ)માં, વીજળી બનાવવા વપરાય.
બિટ્યુમિનસ: ઊંડે દટાયેલો અને વધુ તાપમાન પામેલો કોલસો; સૌથી લોકપ્રિય વ્યાપારી કોલસો; ધાતુશોધન કોલસો ઊંચી ગુણવત્તાનો બિટ્યુમિનસ છે જે વાતભઠ્ઠીમાં લોખંડ ગાળવામાં વપરાય છે.
ઍન્થ્રેસાઇટ: સૌથી ઊંચી ગુણવત્તાનો કઠણ કોલસો.

questions.question: Which one of the following minerals is formed by decomposition of rocks, leaving a residual mass of weathered material?
questions.explanation: Bauxite forms when soluble constituents of surface rocks are removed.
option_feedback: Gold is found in placer deposits.
Zinc occurs in veins and lodes.
questions.question_hi: इनमें से कौन-सा खनिज अपक्षयित पदार्थ के अवशिष्ट भार को छोड़ता हुआ चट्टानों के अपघटन से बनता है?
questions.question_gu: આમાંથી કયું ખનિજ ઘસાયેલા પદાર્થનો અવશેષ છોડીને ખડકોના વિઘટનથી બને છે?
questions.explanation_hi: सतही चट्टानों के घुलनशील तत्व हटने पर बॉक्साइट बनता है।
questions.explanation_gu: સપાટીના ખડકોના દ્રાવ્ય ઘટકો દૂર થતાં બૉક્સાઇટ બને છે.
option_feedback_hi: कोयला अवसादी परतों में बनता है।
सोना प्लेसर निक्षेपों में मिलता है।
जस्ता शिराओं और परतों में होता है।
option_feedback_gu: જસત શિરાઓ અને લોડ્સમાં હોય છે.

questions.question: Koderma, in Jharkhand is the leading producer of which one of the following minerals?
questions.explanation: The Koderma-Gaya-Hazaribagh belt leads in mica.
option_feedback: Iron ore comes from belts like Odisha-Jharkhand.
Copper comes from Balaghat, Khetri and Singhbhum.
Bauxite comes from Amarkantak, Maikal and Koraput.
questions.question_hi: झारखंड में स्थित कोडरमा निम्नलिखित में से किस खनिज का अग्रणी उत्पादक है?
questions.question_gu: ઝારખંડમાં આવેલું કોડરમા નીચેનામાંથી કયા ખનિજનું અગ્રણી ઉત્પાદક છે?
questions.explanation_hi: कोडरमा-गया-हज़ारीबाग़ पेटी अभ्रक में अग्रणी है।
questions.explanation_gu: કોડરમા-ગયા-હજારીબાગ પટ્ટો અબરખમાં અગ્રણી છે.
option_feedback_hi: लौह अयस्क ओडिशा-झारखंड जैसी पेटियों से आता है।
ताँबा बालाघाट, खेतड़ी और सिंहभूम से आता है।
बॉक्साइट अमरकंटक, मैकाल और कोरापुट से आता है।
option_feedback_gu: લોખંડની ખનિજ ઓડિશા-ઝારખંડ જેવા પટ્ટામાંથી આવે છે.
તાંબું બાલાઘાટ, ખેતડી અને સિંહભૂમમાંથી આવે છે.
બૉક્સાઇટ અમરકંટક, મૈકલ અને કોરાપુટમાંથી આવે છે.

questions.question: Minerals are deposited and accumulated in the strata of which of the following rocks?
questions.explanation: In sedimentary rocks minerals occur in beds or layers.
option_feedback: Minerals there occur in veins and lodes.
Sedimentary rocks have beds or layers.
Minerals there occur in cracks and crevices.
questions.question_hi: निम्नलिखित चट्टानों में से किस चट्टान के स्तरों में खनिजों का निक्षेपण और संचयन होता है?
questions.question_gu: નીચેના ખડકોમાંથી કયા ખડકના સ્તરોમાં ખનિજોનો નિક્ષેપ અને સંચય થાય છે?
questions.explanation_hi: अवसादी चट्टानों में खनिज संस्तरों या परतों में मिलते हैं।
questions.explanation_gu: જળકૃત ખડકોમાં ખનિજો થર કે સ્તરોમાં મળે છે.
option_feedback_hi: वहाँ खनिज शिराओं और परतों में मिलते हैं।
अवसादी चट्टानों में संस्तर होते हैं।
वहाँ खनिज दरारों में मिलते हैं।
option_feedback_gu: ત્યાં ખનિજો શિરાઓ અને લોડ્સમાં મળે છે.

questions.question: Which one of the following minerals is contained in the Monazite sand?
questions.explanation: The monazite sands of Kerala are rich in thorium.
option_feedback: Uranium is in Jharkhand and the Aravallis.
questions.question_hi: मोनाज़ाइट रेत में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा खनिज पाया जाता है?
questions.question_gu: મોનાઝાઇટ રેતીમાં નીચેનામાંથી કયું ખનિજ મળે છે?
questions.explanation_hi: केरल की मोनाज़ाइट रेत थोरियम से भरपूर है।
questions.explanation_gu: કેરલની મોનાઝાઇટ રેતી થોરિયમથી સમૃદ્ધ છે.
option_feedback_hi: यूरेनियम झारखंड और अरावली में है।

questions.question: Distinguish between ferrous and non-ferrous minerals. Give examples.
answer_steps: Ferrous minerals contain iron, e.g. iron ore and manganese; they account for about three-fourths of the value of metallic mineral production.
Non-ferrous minerals do not contain iron, e.g. copper, bauxite, lead, zinc and gold.
India is rich in ferrous minerals, but its reserves and production of non-ferrous minerals are not very satisfactory.
questions.question_hi: लौह और अलौह खनिजों में अंतर स्पष्ट करें। उदाहरण भी दें।
questions.question_gu: લોહ અને અલોહ ખનિજો વચ્ચે તફાવત સ્પષ્ટ કરો. ઉદાહરણો પણ આપો.
answer_steps_hi: लौह खनिजों में लोहा होता है, जैसे लौह अयस्क और मैंगनीज़; ये धात्विक खनिजों के उत्पादन मूल्य का लगभग तीन-चौथाई हैं।
अलौह खनिजों में लोहा नहीं होता, जैसे ताँबा, बॉक्साइट, सीसा, जस्ता और सोना।
भारत लौह खनिजों में समृद्ध है, पर अलौह खनिजों के भंडार और उत्पादन बहुत संतोषजनक नहीं हैं।
answer_steps_gu: લોહ ખનિજોમાં લોખંડ હોય છે, જેમ કે લોખંડની ખનિજ અને મૅંગેનીઝ; તે ધાત્વિક ખનિજોના ઉત્પાદન મૂલ્યનો આશરે ત્રણ-ચતુર્થાંશ ભાગ છે.
અલોહ ખનિજોમાં લોખંડ હોતું નથી, જેમ કે તાંબું, બૉક્સાઇટ, સીસું, જસત અને સોનું.
ભારત લોહ ખનિજોમાં સમૃદ્ધ છે, પણ અલોહ ખનિજોના ભંડાર અને ઉત્પાદન બહુ સંતોષકારક નથી.

questions.question: Distinguish between conventional and non-conventional sources of energy.
answer_steps: Conventional sources have been used for a long time: firewood, cattle dung cake, coal, petroleum, natural gas and electricity (hydel and thermal).
Non-conventional sources are newer: solar, wind, tidal, geothermal, biogas and atomic energy.
Most conventional sources (fossil fuels) are non-renewable and polluting; most non-conventional sources are renewable and cleaner.
questions.question_hi: ऊर्जा के परंपरागत और ग़ैर-परंपरागत साधनों में अंतर कीजिए।
questions.question_gu: ઊર્જાના પરંપરાગત અને બિનપરંપરાગત સ્રોતો વચ્ચે તફાવત કરો.
answer_steps_hi: परंपरागत साधन लंबे समय से प्रयुक्त हैं: लकड़ी, उपले, कोयला, पेट्रोलियम, प्राकृतिक गैस और विद्युत (जल और ताप)।
ग़ैर-परंपरागत साधन नए हैं: सौर, पवन, ज्वारीय, भूतापीय, बायोगैस और परमाणु ऊर्जा।
अधिकांश परंपरागत साधन (जीवाश्म ईंधन) अनवीकरण योग्य और प्रदूषणकारी हैं; अधिकांश ग़ैर-परंपरागत साधन नवीकरण योग्य और स्वच्छ हैं।
answer_steps_gu: પરંપરાગત સ્રોતો લાંબા સમયથી વપરાય છે: લાકડાં, છાણાં, કોલસો, પેટ્રોલિયમ, કુદરતી વાયુ અને વીજળી (જળ અને તાપ).

questions.question: Why do we need to conserve mineral resources?
answer_steps: Workable mineral deposits are an insignificant fraction (one per cent) of the Earth's crust.
Geological processes of mineral formation are so slow that the rate of replenishment is infinitely small compared with consumption.
Minerals are finite and non-renewable; rich deposits are being used up fast.
Continued extraction raises costs as minerals come from greater depths with lower quality.
So we must use minerals in a planned and sustainable way, use technology for low-grade ores, and recycle metals and use scrap and substitutes.

questions.question: Describe the distribution of non-conventional energy resources in India.
answer_steps: Nuclear: uranium and thorium in Jharkhand and the Aravallis of Rajasthan; thorium in the monazite sands of Kerala; plants at Narora, Kakrapara, Tarapur and Kalpakkam.
Solar: India is tropical; one of the largest solar plants is near Bhuj (Madhapur), where it sterilises milk cans.
Wind: the largest cluster is from Nagarcoil to Madurai in Tamil Nadu; also Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Gujarat, Kerala, Maharashtra and Lakshadweep; Jaisalmer is well known.
Biogas: gobar gas plants in rural areas at municipal, co-operative and individual levels.
Tidal: Gulf of Khambhat and Gulf of Kachchh (Gujarat) and the Sunderban delta (West Bengal); geothermal: Parvati valley (Himachal Pradesh) and Puga Valley (Ladakh).

questions.question: Describe three modes of occurrence of minerals.
answer_steps: In igneous and metamorphic rocks, minerals occur in cracks, crevices, faults or joints as veins and lodes (tin, copper, zinc, lead).
In sedimentary rocks, minerals occur in beds or layers (coal, some iron ore; gypsum, potash and sodium salt from evaporation).
By decomposition of surface rocks, a residual mass of ores remains (bauxite); also placer deposits (gold, tin) and ocean waters (salt, magnesium, bromine).

questions.question: How is petroleum trapped in rocks?
answer_steps: Most petroleum in India occurs in anticlines and fault traps in tertiary rocks.
In anticlines or domes, oil is trapped in the crest of the upfold within porous limestone or sandstone, held by non-porous layers above and below.
In fault traps, oil is held between porous and non-porous rocks; gas, being lighter, usually occurs above the oil.

questions.question: Explain how tidal energy is produced and name the places in India suited for it.
answer_steps: Floodgate dams are built across inlets; at high tide, water flows in and is trapped when the gate is closed.
When the tide falls outside, the stored water flows back to the sea through a pipe that turns a power-generating turbine.
Ideal places: the Gulf of Khambhat and the Gulf of Kachchh (Gujarat) and the Gangetic delta in the Sunderban (West Bengal).

questions.question: Describe the distribution of iron ore in India.
answer_steps: Odisha-Jharkhand belt: high-grade hematite at Badampahar (Mayurbhanj and Kendujhar, Odisha) and Gua and Noamundi (Singhbhum, Jharkhand).
Durg-Bastar-Chandrapur belt (Chhattisgarh and Maharashtra): super high-grade hematite in the Bailadila hills of Bastar, exported to Japan and South Korea via Visakhapatnam.
Ballari-Chitradurga-Chikkamagaluru-Tumakuru belt (Karnataka): large reserves; Kudremukh is a 100% export unit sending ore as slurry by pipeline to a port near Mangaluru.
Maharashtra-Goa belt: Goa and Ratnagiri; ore not of very high quality but efficiently exploited and exported through Marmagao.
Magnetite (up to 70% iron) is the finest ore; hematite (50-60%) is the most used.

questions.question: Why is there a need to develop non-conventional sources of energy? Describe any three.
answer_steps: Growing consumption makes India dependent on fossil fuels; rising oil and gas prices and possible shortages threaten energy security, and fossil fuels cause pollution.
Nuclear energy: altering atoms releases heat; uranium and thorium from Jharkhand, the Aravallis and Kerala's monazite sands.
Solar energy: photovoltaic technology turns sunlight into electricity; a large plant near Bhuj sterilises milk cans; it reduces rural dependence on firewood and dung cakes.
Wind energy: the largest cluster is from Nagarcoil to Madurai in Tamil Nadu; Jaisalmer is also known for wind energy.
Geothermal (Parvati valley, Puga Valley), tidal (Gulf of Khambhat, Kachchh, Sunderban) and biogas are other renewable options.
